value.title: Oath Under Snow
value.synopsis: The world's destruction progresses. The only thing that can stop it is Miyu's sacrifice that is worthy of the Grail. When Ainsworth asks Illya, the one who carries the title of the world's savior, what she will save between the world and Miyu, she chooses the simple and selfish answer of "both." In a respite from the fighting, they all rest in the house Miyu and Shirō took care of. When they gather in a circle, Shirō tells them about himself and Miyu. She was the Child of God that granted any and all wishes. Shirō took in the girl who had no one else into the household that he had shared with Kiritsugu. It has been five years since then, and now they have lived peacefully like siblings. But that peaceful everyday life has now been shattered. They will take her back, but before that, Julian makes his appearance, still seeking in Miyu the miracle that he needs.

value.title: Prisma Phantasm
value.synopsis: Come Carvival Phantasm fa per Fate e Tsukihime questo OAV fa la parodia della serie Prisma Illya. Sono rivisti in chiave ironica alcuni eventi e sono presentati alcuni personaggi che non compaiono nella serie Majokko originale con tante battute ed allusioni sessuali di ogni tipo. By Animeclick

value.title: Licht Nameless Girl
value.synopsis: A moment of rest from the fierce battle with Ainsworth. Ilya and the others who rescued Miyu are informed by Shiro Emiya of the parallel world about Miyu's past and the Holy Cup War that occurred in this world. It was Miyu's sad fate, and it was the story of a fierce battle that her brother Shiro fought for Miyu's life. Ainsworth sacrifices Miyu to save humanity. Shiro decides to become the enemy of the world for Miyu. Ilya vows to protect everything in two conflicting justices. "I'll help. I decided to find a way to help everyone!" To create a tomorrow where you can laugh with your loved ones―.. The battle of magical girls begins again ...!

value.title: Ruby-chan's Exciting Bloomer-Filled Review
value.synopsis: Illya and Rin review their first (mis)adventures together with Ruby's help and play by play commentary.

value.title: Quiz Magical Rubyonaire
value.synopsis: Illya takes part in Ruby's tormenting game show bizarrely centered on her brother.

value.title: La maghetta alle terme
value.synopsis: Illya and co. go to a hot springs inn, where Rin and Luvia are carrying out a secret mission. During the trip, Kuro discovers that the hot springs cause a greater drain on her mana than usual, so Illya and Miyu make up for it by doing other fun activities with her. Later that night, the girls investigate a magic point, which creates a hidden hot spring and rectifies the properties of the hot springs in the region.

value.title: Beast, Again!
value.synopsis: Miyu and Chloe will encounter "that" Beast form...

value.title: Ruby's Observation Records of Miyu-san's Baths
value.synopsis: Sapphire finds her unconscious sister Ruby and checks the black box to figure out what happened to her.
